entries.label: ANY.RUN
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · Interactive sandbox: detonate a file or URL and click through it live while process, network and ATT&CK activity is recorded.

entries.label: CyberChef
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · GCHQ's browser toolkit for decoding, decompressing and converting almost anything: base64, gzip, XOR, hex and hundreds more, chained into recipes.

entries.label: Decompiler Explorer
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · Upload a small binary and compare the output of several decompilers side by side.

entries.label: Hybrid Analysis
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · Free sandbox with detailed behavioural reports, plus a large searchable archive of other people's submissions.

entries.label: Joe Sandbox
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · Deep automated analysis on Windows, Linux, macOS and Android, with a free public cloud tier for non-sensitive samples.

entries.label: Malpedia
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · Encyclopedia of malware families: aliases, the actors using them, YARA rules and curated reporting for each.

entries.label: MalwareBazaar
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · abuse.ch's open malware repository. Search by hash, tag, signature or YARA rule and pull the sample for analysis.

entries.label: ThreatFox
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · abuse.ch's shared feed of indicators tied to named malware: C2 servers, payload URLs and hashes.

entries.label: Triage
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · Fast sandbox with strong malware family detection and config extraction: C2 addresses and keys pulled straight out of the sample.

entries.label: UnpacMe
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · Automated unpacking: strips common packers and returns the payloads inside, with hashes to pivot on.

entries.label: URLhaus
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · abuse.ch's database of URLs currently serving malware, with the payloads they drop.

entries.label: VirusTotal
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · Run a hash, file, URL, domain or IP past dozens of engines, then follow the relations graph to linked samples and infrastructure.

entries.label: YARAify
entries.detail: OSINT · Files · abuse.ch's YARA service: scan a file against public rules, or see which samples a rule has matched.

entries.label: AbuseIPDB
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Community-reported abuse history for an IP address: who reported it, when, and for what, from brute forcing to port scanning.

entries.label: bgp.tools
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · A live BGP view of a network: what prefixes an ASN announces, who it peers with and when that changed.

entries.label: Censys
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Host and certificate search with deep service fingerprints; strong for tracking a server set-up across IPs.

entries.label: crt.sh
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Certificate Transparency search. Finds a domain's subdomains, and new look-alike domains the moment they get a certificate.

entries.label: DNSDumpster
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Maps a domain's subdomains, mail and name servers from passive DNS, and draws the result as a graph.

entries.label: GreyNoise
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Tells you whether an IP is background internet-wide scanning or something aimed at you.

entries.label: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Quick lookups for ASNs, prefixes and peers; the fastest way to see who owns a range and what else they announce.

entries.label: ICANN Lookup
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · The registry's own RDAP record for a domain: registrar, dates, status and name servers, without a reseller's adverts in the way.

entries.label: IPinfo
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · A quick answer to who owns an IP: ASN, hosting company, rough location and whether it is a VPN, proxy or Tor exit.

entries.label: MXToolbox
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Mail records, SPF, DMARC and blocklist checks for a domain or mail server.

entries.label: RIPEstat
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Authoritative routing data for any IP or AS: who holds it, where it is announced, and how that has changed.

entries.label: Scamalytics
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Fraud risk score for an IP address, flagging proxies, VPNs, Tor exits and datacentre ranges.

entries.label: SecurityTrails
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Historical DNS and WHOIS: see what a domain pointed to before it moved, and what else shared its IP.

entries.label: Shodan
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Internet-wide scan data: which services, banners and software versions an IP exposes, and every other host that matches.

entries.label: urlscan.io
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Loads a URL in a sandbox and records screenshots, the DOM and every request, then lets you pivot on IPs, hashes and domains across historic scans.

entries.label: Validin
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Passive DNS and host-response history with a generous free tier; quick for following an actor's infrastructure over time.

entries.label: ViewDNS.info
entries.detail: OSINT · Infrastructure · Reverse IP, reverse WHOIS and DNS history in one place: find the other domains sharing a server or a registrant.

entries.label: BuiltWith
entries.detail: OSINT · Code · What a site is built on, plus its analytics and ad IDs and the other sites that share them.

entries.label: GitHub code search
entries.detail: OSINT · Code · Search all public code on GitHub with qualifiers for path, language and organisation. Needs a free account.

entries.label: grep.app
entries.detail: OSINT · Code · Regex search across half a million public Git repositories. Good for finding where a leaked key, hostname or odd string turns up.

entries.label: PublicWWW
entries.detail: OSINT · Code · Searches the HTML and JavaScript of live websites, so a shared analytics ID or snippet leads to every site that carries it.

entries.label: ADS-B Exchange
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · The long-running unfiltered ADS-B network, with global coverage and track history.

entries.label: airplanes.live
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · Community-run, unfiltered ADS-B map: military and blocked aircraft stay visible, with history playback.

entries.label: DVLA vehicle enquiry
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · Official UK check of a number plate: make, colour, tax and MOT status, first registration.

entries.label: Flightradar24
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · The most complete live map of airline traffic, with playback and aircraft history on paid tiers.

entries.label: Freedar
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · UK community flight tracker built on ADS-B and MLAT feeds, showing military and private aircraft that commercial trackers often hide.

entries.label: Global Fishing Watch
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · AIS combined with satellite radar detections, so it shows vessels running dark with AIS switched off.

entries.label: MarineTraffic
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · Live AIS positions for ships worldwide, with vessel details and port calls.

entries.label: MOT history
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · Every MOT test for a UK vehicle, with mileage at each test and the faults found.

entries.label: N2YO
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · Live satellite tracking and pass predictions: what is overhead, and when an imaging satellite will next see a place.

entries.label: OpenSky Network
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · Research-grade archive of ADS-B data; the place to go for historical flight tracks.

entries.label: Planespotters.net
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · Airframe histories by registration or serial: operators, re-registrations and photos.

entries.label: Platesmania
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · Crowd-sourced photos of number plates; useful for matching a vehicle to a place and time.

entries.label: VesselFinder
entries.detail: OSINT · Tracking · Live AIS ship positions and vessel details by name, IMO or MMSI. A useful second opinion to MarineTraffic.

entries.label: ACLED
entries.detail: OSINT · Conflict · Structured, coded data on political violence and protest worldwide. Free account needed for downloads.

entries.label: Airwars
entries.detail: OSINT · Conflict · Civilian harm from military action, logged incident by incident with sources and locations.

entries.label: DeepStateMap
entries.detail: OSINT · Conflict · Daily-updated map of the front line in Ukraine, showing occupied ground, contested areas and recent advances.

entries.label: GeoConfirmed
entries.detail: OSINT · Conflict · Volunteer-geolocated footage from several conflicts, each pinned to the map with its source.

entries.label: GPSJam
entries.detail: OSINT · Conflict · Daily map of GPS interference, worked out from what aircraft report.

entries.label: ISW maps
entries.detail: OSINT · Conflict · The Institute for the Study of War's daily assessments and interactive control-of-terrain maps.

entries.label: Liveuamap
entries.detail: OSINT · Conflict · Near-real-time incident map built from news and social media, covering many regions.

entries.label: NASA FIRMS
entries.detail: OSINT · Conflict · Satellite thermal detections within hours of a pass; often the first confirmation of a strike or a large fire.

entries.label: Oryx
entries.detail: OSINT · Conflict · Lists of military equipment losses where every entry links to photo or video proof.

entries.label: Bellingcat OSM Search
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · Finds places by a combination of features, such as a church near a railway line and a river.

entries.label: Copernicus Browser
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · Free Sentinel satellite imagery with time-lapse and comparison, often only days old.

entries.label: GeoHints
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · Country-by-country visual clues: bollards, road markings, plates, poles and scripts.

entries.label: Google Earth
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · 3D imagery everywhere. Google Earth Pro on desktop adds historical imagery, often going back decades.

entries.label: Mapillary
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · Crowd-sourced street-level imagery, often where Google Street View has never been.

entries.label: OpenStreetMap
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · The open map underneath many other tools. Often names paths, buildings and features that commercial maps leave out.

entries.label: Overpass Turbo
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · Write your own OpenStreetMap queries when a ready-made search is not precise enough.

entries.label: PeakFinder
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · Draws the mountain skyline from any point, to match against the ridge line in a photo.

entries.label: PeakVisor
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · 3D terrain with named peaks; match a mountain skyline in a photo to where it was taken.

entries.label: SunCalc
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · Sun position and shadow direction for any place and time; the standard way to date a photo from its shadows.

entries.label: Wikimapia
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · Crowd-tagged satellite map with outlines and notes on buildings and sites that other maps leave unnamed.

entries.label: Zoom Earth
entries.detail: OSINT · Geolocation · Near-live satellite imagery with weather, fires and storms. Handy for checking the cloud cover on a claimed date.

entries.label: Bing Visual Search
entries.detail: OSINT · Verification · Another reverse image engine. Worth running alongside Google, Yandex and TinEye, because each indexes different things.

entries.label: ExifTool
entries.detail: OSINT · Verification · The reference tool for reading and writing file metadata: camera, GPS, timestamps, software.

entries.label: Forensically
entries.detail: OSINT · Verification · Error level analysis, clone detection and noise analysis in the browser, to spot edited regions.

entries.label: FotoForensics
entries.detail: OSINT · Verification · Error level analysis and metadata for an uploaded image, with tutorials on reading the results.

entries.label: Google Lens
entries.detail: OSINT · Verification · General reverse image search; good on products, text and landmarks.

entries.label: InVID-WeVerify plugin
entries.detail: OSINT · Verification · Browser extension for verifying video and images: keyframes, reverse search, metadata and forensic filters.

entries.label: Jimpl
entries.detail: OSINT · Verification · Online EXIF viewer: drop in a photo to read camera, date and GPS tags without installing anything.

entries.label: TinEye
entries.detail: OSINT · Verification · Finds where else an image has appeared; sort by oldest to find the earliest copy.

entries.label: Yandex Images
entries.detail: OSINT · Verification · The strongest reverse image search for places, buildings and faces.

entries.label: Epieos
entries.detail: OSINT · People · What an email address or phone number is registered to, including linked Google accounts.

entries.label: Have I Been Pwned
entries.detail: OSINT · People · Which known data breaches an email address appears in, and what was exposed.

entries.label: Hunter
entries.detail: OSINT · People · Email addresses published for a company's domain, and the pattern its addresses follow.

entries.label: Intelligence X
entries.detail: OSINT · People · Search engine over leaks, pastes, the dark web and historical web data, by email, domain, IP or crypto address.

entries.label: OSINT Industries
entries.detail: OSINT · People · Email, phone or username lookups across a very wide range of services, with results in one report.

entries.label: Sherlock
entries.detail: OSINT · People · Command-line username search across hundreds of social networks.

entries.label: TGStat
entries.detail: OSINT · People · Search and analytics for Telegram channels and posts, including mentions and forwards between channels.

entries.label: WhatsMyName
entries.detail: OSINT · People · Checks a username across hundreds of sites at once.

entries.label: Arkham
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · Crypto analytics that labels who owns which wallets, and traces flows between them.

entries.label: Companies House
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · Official register of UK companies: officers, owners, filings and addresses, all searchable.

entries.label: Etherscan
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · The standard Ethereum explorer: transactions, tokens, contracts and labelled addresses.

entries.label: GLEIF LEI search
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · The global Legal Entity Identifier register: who a company is, and who its direct and ultimate parents are.

entries.label: HM Land Registry
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · Who owns a property in England and Wales; title registers cost a few pounds each.

entries.label: ICIJ Offshore Leaks
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · Searchable entities and officers from the Panama, Paradise and Pandora Papers and other leaks.

entries.label: mempool.space
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · Open-source Bitcoin explorer for transactions, addresses and fees.

entries.label: OCCRP Aleph
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · Search across leaks, registries and investigative datasets gathered by OCCRP journalists.

entries.label: OFAC sanctions search
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · The US Treasury's own sanctions list search, including listed crypto addresses.

entries.label: OpenCorporates
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · The largest open database of companies worldwide, across many jurisdictions.

entries.label: OpenSanctions
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · Sanctions lists, politically exposed people and criminal watchlists merged into one search.

entries.label: SEC EDGAR full-text search
entries.detail: OSINT · Money · Full-text search of US company filings since 2001: names, addresses and subsidiaries buried in annual reports.

entries.label: archive.today
entries.detail: OSINT · Archives · On-demand snapshots that often capture pages the Wayback Machine cannot, such as social media posts.

entries.label: Arquivo.pt
entries.detail: OSINT · Archives · Portugal's national web archive, with broad international coverage and full-text search of old pages.

entries.label: Ghostarchive
entries.detail: OSINT · Archives · Archives videos and pages that other archives struggle with, including YouTube and social media posts.

entries.label: Wayback Machine
entries.detail: OSINT · Archives · Snapshots of the web going back to 1996, plus Save Page Now to archive something before it changes.

entries.label: Bellingcat Online Investigation Toolkit
entries.detail: OSINT · Methods · Bellingcat's maintained, annotated index of tools and how to use them, by investigation type.

entries.label: OSINT Framework
entries.detail: OSINT · Methods · A clickable tree of tools sorted by what you are looking for. Broad rather than curated, so check what you find.
